learning_outcomes.text: Study in depth the design of basic building blocks of multistage amplifiers implemented in integrated circuit.
Provide students with general knowledge on electronics, with a special focus on analog electronics.
Develop skills to design electronic circuits of medium complexity.

syllabus_topics: Basic building blocks of integrated-circuit (IC) amplifiers
Frequency response, feedback and frequency compensation in IC amplifiers
teaching_methods: Theoretical-practical classes to solve practical exercises
Practical classes to carry out lab experiments
bibliography: Adel S. Sedra & Kenneth C. Smith, Microlelectronic Circuits, 5th edition, Oxford University Press, ISBN 978-0-19-514252-5, 2004.
Albert P. Malvino & David J. Bates, Electronic Principles, 8th edition, McGraw-Hill, ISBN 978-1-25-925266-2, 2016.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
